risk_if_not_implemented: Without Truncated Banner, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Loss of Authorization / Certification / License (R-EX-11), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to establish, maintain and disseminate policies, standards and procedures necessary for secure, compliant and resilient capabilities.
compensating_control_1.justification: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation (GOV-04) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Truncated Banner (SEA-28.2) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: System Use Notification (Logon Banner)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize system use notification / logon banners that display an approved system use notification message or banner before granting access to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_2.justification: System Use Notification (Logon Banner) (SEA-28) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Truncated Banner (SEA-28.2) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
